{"file_path":"tests/test_loader.py","content":"import pytest

from sales_dashboard.loader import (
    daily_conversion_counts,
    dedupe_sessions,
    parse_session_log,
)


def test_parse_session_log_flags_and_field_whitespace():
    assert parse_session_log([" a , 1 , 1 \n", " b , -2 , 0 ", " c , 3 , \n"]) == [
        {"id": "a", "day": 1, "converted": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": -2, "converted": False},
        {"id": "c", "day": 3, "converted": None},
    ]


def test_parse_session_log_skips_blank_and_comment_lines():
    lines = ["", " \t\n", "# comment", " \t# another,comment", "a,1,1", "\n"]
    assert parse_session_log(iter(lines)) == [{"id": "a", "day": 1, "converted": True}]
    assert parse_session_log([]) == []
    assert parse_session_log(["# comment", "   "]) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_line", ["a,1", "a,1,1,extra", "a,not-a-day,1", "a,1.5,0", "a,,1"])
def test_parse_session_log_errors_include_original_line_number(bad_line):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"line 4\b"):
        parse_session_log(["", "  # comment", "ok,1,0", bad_line])


def test_dedupe_sessions_keeps_last_duplicate_id_and_sorts():
    events = [
        {"id": "a", "day": 9, "converted": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": 2, "converted": False},
        {"id": "a", "day": 2, "converted": False},
        {"id": "c", "day": 1, "converted": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": 2, "converted": True},
    ]
    assert dedupe_sessions(events) == [events[3], events[2], events[4]]
    assert dedupe_sessions([]) == []


def test_daily_conversion_counts_inclusive_range_and_gaps():
    events = [
        {"day": 0, "converted": True},
        {"day": 1, "converted": True},
        {"day": 1, "converted": True},
        {"day": 2, "converted": False},
        {"day": 2, "converted": None},
        {"day": 4, "converted": True},
        {"day": 5, "converted": True},
    ]
    assert daily_conversion_counts(events, 1, 4) == [2, 0, 0, 1]
    assert daily_conversion_counts(events, 1, 1) == [2]
    assert daily_conversion_counts(events, 4, 1) == []


def test_daily_conversion_counts_no_events():
    assert daily_conversion_counts([], -1, 1) == [0, 0, 0]
    assert daily_conversion_counts([], 1, 0) == []
